stories.h: Fountain of Life Church removes Jimmy Odukoya as senior pastor
stories.p: The board of trustees of The Fountain of Life Church in Lagos has reportedly removed Jimmy Odukoya as senior pastor with immediate effect. It said his appointment did not reflect the succession wishes of his late father and founder, Taiwo Odukoya.
body: The Fountain of Life Church in Ilupeju, Lagos, has reportedly removed Jimmy Odukoya as its senior pastor, with the board of trustees saying his appointment conflicted with the succession plans left by the church's late founder, Taiwo Odukoya.
## What the board said

In a statement on Tuesday, 17 November 2026, the board is said to have explained that it reviewed the church's constitution alongside recordings of the founder's wishes made before his death in 2023. It concluded that Jimmy's tenure did not reflect those wishes and said he was no longer recognised as senior pastor, effective immediately.

The board reportedly stressed that the decision was not a personal judgement against him but a governance matter, describing it as necessary to uphold the church's constitution and preserve the succession arrangements set up by the founder. It said the decision was not taken lightly.
## Background

Jimmy Odukoya, an actor and pastor, took over leadership of the church after his father's death. Earlier this month, on 1 November, he remarried and presented his new wife to the congregation, in a ceremony at which Pastor Tunde Bakare officiated the blessing.
## How people reacted

The news quickly became a talking point online, with many people revisiting a cryptic post he shared days before the announcement, and a video of the late founder that is said to show the role he intended for his son.
## What happens next
There was no public response from Jimmy Odukoya in the reports, and the board did not say who would lead the church.
more: The board says the founder's succession wishes were not followed.
It says the decision is not personal.
No response from Jimmy Odukoya has been reported.

stories.h: No NIN, no flight: FG sets 1 January deadline for domestic air passengers
stories.p: Passengers without a valid National Identification Number will be refused boarding on domestic flights from 1 January 2027. Aviation Minister Festus Keyamo announced the rule while unveiling a new passenger verification system.
body: The federal government has announced that passengers without a valid National Identification Number (NIN) will not be allowed to board domestic flights from 1 January 2027.
## The new system

Minister of Aviation and Aerospace Development Festus Keyamo announced the policy while unveiling the Verified Passenger Authentication System (VPASS), a digital platform that links passengers' identities directly to their NIN records.
Keyamo said the system will help authorities confirm genuine passengers, prevent unauthorised access to restricted airport areas and make sure airline passenger lists are accurate.
## Why it is being introduced

The minister pointed to irregularities in ticket sales, including bulk buying and reselling of tickets under different identities, as problems the government wants to stop. He said tying bookings to verified identity records would make it harder for anyone to travel using false details.
## What airlines must do
Keyamo directed the Nigerian Civil Aviation Authority (NCAA) to ensure that domestic airlines connect to the platform before 31 December 2026, ahead of the January deadline.
## What it means for travellers
Anyone planning to fly within Nigeria in the new year will need to make sure their NIN is valid and matches the details they use to book tickets.
more: The rule starts on 1 January 2027.
Airlines must link up to the VPASS system by 31 December.
It aims to stop ticket fraud and fake identities.

stories.h: Aremu Afolayan reportedly clashes with Isbae U on Curiosity Made Me Ask
stories.p: Actor Aremu Afolayan's appearance on Isbae U's show Curiosity Made Me Ask reportedly ended in a heated exchange. He took offence when the host compared their late fathers.
body: Nollywood actor Aremu Afolayan has become a talking point online after his appearance on comedian Isbae U's interview show, Curiosity Made Me Ask, reportedly ended in a heated exchange.
## What happened

Isbae U, known for his sarcastic interview style, is said to have questioned whether Aremu was still active in Nollywood and made jokes about his body and how he earns a living given his few recent film roles.

Aremu reportedly explained that he has stayed away from film sets because of insecurity, saying travelling for shoots had become dangerous and he was not willing to risk his life for a role paying ₦2 million or ₦3 million.
## Where it went wrong

The mood reportedly changed when Isbae U brought up his own late father, actor Sir K. Kamoru, and compared him with Aremu's late father, the veteran filmmaker Ade Love Afolayan. Aremu is said to have taken offence and warned the host against such comparisons, insisting his father's contribution to the film industry was not up for debate. He also reportedly questioned Isbae U's own achievements as an actor.
more: The row started over a comparison of their late fathers.
Aremu says insecurity keeps him off film sets.
He questioned the host's own achievements as an actor.

stories.h: MTN reopens talks to buy South Africa's Telkom
stories.p: MTN Group has confirmed early talks to buy rival Telkom, four years after an earlier attempt collapsed. Telkom shares jumped 18% on the news.
body: MTN Group, Africa's largest mobile operator by subscribers, has reportedly reopened talks to acquire South African rival Telkom.
## What happened

The two companies confirmed preliminary discussions on Monday, 16 November 2026, four years after an earlier round of negotiations ended without a deal. MTN said it was considering a cash offer, possibly with an option for Telkom shareholders to take MTN shares instead, but stressed the talks were at an early stage and might not lead to an agreement.
## Market reaction

Telkom's shares rose about 18% to their highest level in more than seven years, while MTN's shares fell 1.7%. Telkom's enterprise value was put at about 38 billion rand, or around $2.2 billion, while MTN's market value stood at about 432 billion rand.
## Why it matters
A deal would add Telkom's mobile customers to MTN's South African business, which could push MTN ahead of Vodacom as the biggest mobile operator in South Africa by subscribers.
more: The talks are at an early stage.
Telkom shares rose about 18%.
A deal could make MTN South Africa's biggest mobile operator.

stories.h: Peller vows to unfollow the Grammys after Ice King Ochacho misses out on nomination
stories.p: Streamer Peller has reportedly criticised the Recording Academy for leaving young singer Ice King Ochacho out of the 2027 Grammy nominations. He said he would unfollow the Grammys in protest.
body: Popular streamer Peller has reportedly hit out at the Recording Academy after young singer Ice King Ochacho was left out of the 2027 Grammy nominations.
## What Peller said

In a video that circulated online on Monday, 16 November 2026, Peller is said to have voiced his frustration at the snub and declared that he would unfollow the Grammys' account. He reportedly argued that the Academy should even have created a special category to recognise the young performer.
## Who is Ice King Ochacho

Ice King Ochacho, a teenager, is the son of businessman King Ochacho. He released his debut album, The Future, in October 2026, featuring collaborations with established artists, and his single No Competition reportedly passed one million streams on Spotify.
## Background
Peller has been one of the young singer's loudest supporters. In September, King Ochacho recalled that the streamer had earlier predicted his son would one day win a Grammy.
The 2027 Grammy nominations, announced this week, include Nigerian stars Tems, Davido and Ayra Starr.
more: Peller says he will unfollow the Grammys.
Ice King Ochacho released his debut album in October.
Tems, Davido and Ayra Starr made the nominations list.

stories.h: IK Ogbonna and Ego Nwosu reveal viral proposal was a promo for a wedding-themed event
stories.p: Actors IK Ogbonna and Ego Nwosu have reportedly confirmed they are not getting married, after their viral proposal video drew congratulations. They said it was to promote a wedding-themed event in Port Harcourt.
body: Nollywood actors IK Ogbonna and Ego Nwosu have reportedly cleared the air on their viral proposal video, confirming that they are not actually getting married.
## The reveal

In a new video posted on Monday, 16 November 2026, the pair appeared together and explained that the proposal was part of a campaign for an event called Love at Julirose, billed for 15 December in Port Harcourt, Rivers State.

The event is described as a full wedding-themed experience, with a live band, bridesmaids and groomsmen, photographers and live performances. Tickets are on sale with different price levels and a dress code.
## The playful banter
The two kept up the jokes in the new video, with IK saying he was still the groom and Ego replying that she was still the bride, making it clear the campaign was designed to create buzz.
## How fans reacted
Many fans who had congratulated the pair earlier this month reacted with amusement and mock anger, with some jokingly asking for their congratulations back.
more: The proposal promoted an event called Love at Julirose.
The event holds on 15 December in Port Harcourt.
Some fans jokingly asked for their congratulations back.

stories.h: Yul Edochie sparks debate after criticising men who kneel to propose
stories.p: Actor Yul Edochie has reportedly drawn mixed reactions after describing kneeling to propose as a foreign practice that lowers African men. He was reacting to a viral video of a rejected proposal.
body: Nollywood actor Yul Edochie has reportedly sparked a fresh online debate after criticising men who go down on one knee to propose marriage.
## What happened
Yul was reacting to a viral video, said to have been edited, showing a man kneeling to propose to his partner at an event, only for her to turn him down.

In a post on X, he reportedly described kneeling to propose as a practice Africans copied from Western culture, arguing that it reduces the dignity of African men. He used strong language to dismiss men who do it.
## How people reacted

His comments drew a wide range of responses. Some users backed his view on cultural identity, while many others pushed back, saying the way a man proposes has nothing to do with the quality of a marriage, and some criticised the actor directly.
more: He called kneeling to propose a foreign practice.
He was reacting to a viral rejected proposal video.
Social media users are divided over his comments.

stories.h: Labour Party factional candidate Kennedy Ahanotu quits presidential race, backs Tinubu
stories.p: Kennedy Ahanotu, presidential candidate of the Abure-led Labour Party faction, has reportedly withdrawn from the 2027 race and endorsed President Tinubu. He blamed the party's long-running internal crisis.
body: Kennedy Ahanotu, who was chosen as presidential candidate by the Julius Abure-led faction of the Labour Party, has reportedly withdrawn from the 2027 presidential race and thrown his support behind President Bola Tinubu.
## What happened

Ahanotu is said to have announced the decision at a press briefing in Abuja on Monday, 16 November 2026. He said he would work with the City Boy Movement, a pro-Tinubu group, to mobilise support for the president's re-election.

The 42-year-old former national youth leader of the Labour Party, described as an ally of the party's 2023 candidate Peter Obi, reportedly said the move followed consultations with youth leaders from across the country, who concluded that the party's continuing internal crisis made a new direction necessary.
## Background

Ahanotu was adopted as the factional candidate at primaries held in Abuja in May 2026, when the Labour Party was divided between the Abure-led group and the leadership headed by Senator Nenadi Usman. Peter Obi has since moved on to the NDC, where he is running with Rabiu Kwankwaso.
## Betrayal claims
Responding to suggestions that he had betrayed the opposition, Ahanotu reportedly argued that it was the party that had failed its long-standing members, noting that he had joined it in 2016.
No response from either Labour Party faction was included in the reports.
more: Ahanotu was the Abure faction's presidential candidate.
He says he will work with the City Boy Movement.
He blamed the Labour Party's internal crisis.

stories.h: Sanwo-Olu gives Flamingos ₦10m each and iPhones after U-17 World Cup win
stories.p: Lagos Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu has reportedly rewarded the Flamingos with ₦10 million each, iPhone 18 Pro Max phones and other gifts. It follows earlier rewards from President Tinubu and Senate President Akpabio.
body: Lagos State Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu has reportedly rewarded the Flamingos, Nigeria's under-17 women's team, with ₦10 million each and other gifts after their historic win at the 2026 FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup in Morocco.
## The reward

The governor announced the package at a dinner held in honour of the players and technical crew at Lagos House, Marina, on Sunday. It is said to include a total cash reward of ₦300 million, iPhone 18 Pro Max phones, headphones and customised outfits.
## Other rewards

The gesture follows President Bola Tinubu's announcement of ₦100 million for each player and for head coach Akeem Busari, with other members of the technical crew promised ₦50 million each. The presidential reward was announced by First Lady Oluremi Tinubu when she hosted the team in Abuja. Senate President Godswill Akpabio also announced a ₦100 million donation to the team after their return.
## The historic win
The Flamingos made history on 7 November by beating Japan 2-1 in Rabat, becoming the first African team to win the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup.
more: Each player gets ₦10 million from Lagos.
Tinubu earlier promised ₦100 million per player.
The Flamingos beat Japan 2-1 in the final.

stories.h: Pope Leo hit in the eye by rosary thrown from crowd in Peru
stories.p: Pope Leo XIV was reportedly struck in the eye by a rosary thrown from the crowd as he rode through Lima in the Popemobile. He was on the last day of a 12-day South America tour.
body: Pope Leo XIV was reportedly hit in the eye by a rosary thrown by a worshipper as he toured Lima, Peru, on Monday, 16 November 2026.
## What happened

The Pope was riding through the city in the Popemobile when the rosary, thrown from the crowd, struck him. Video of the moment shows him holding and rubbing his eye. There was no report of serious injury, and he continued to a farewell Mass at Las Palmas air base, which was said to have drawn around one million people.
## A special visit

The trip marked the final day of a 12-day tour of South America, six days of which he spent in Peru. The 71-year-old has deep ties to the country. Born in Chicago, he arrived in Peru in 1985 as a 29-year-old Augustinian missionary and spent many years there, including a decade in the northern city of Chiclayo, where he was known as Padre Roberto.
He is the first American pope and the first to hold Peruvian citizenship. Tens of thousands of Peruvians lined the streets on Monday, many carrying banners in his honour.
more: The rosary was thrown as he rode in the Popemobile.
He went on to lead a farewell Mass.
Around one million people attended the Mass.
stories.credit: Photo: Edgar Beltrán / The Pillar / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

stories.h: Raye leads 2027 Grammy nominations with 11, Rosalía next with nine
stories.p: British singer Raye leads the 2027 Grammy nominations with 11, including Album, Song and Record of the Year. Rosalía has nine, and the ceremony holds in Los Angeles on 7 February.
body: British singer-songwriter Raye has led the nominations for the 2027 Grammy Awards with 11 nods, while Spain's Rosalía is second with nine.
## The leaders

Raye is nominated in three of the top categories: Album of the Year, Song of the Year and Record of the Year, for her album This Music May Contain Hope, which mixes pop and R&B with jazz. She also earned a Songwriter of the Year nod for her work with other artists. Rosalía's nominations follow a strong showing at last week's Latin Grammys with her album Lux.
## Others on the list

Country singers Ella Langley, a first-time nominee, and Miranda Lambert have seven each, as do Olivia Rodrigo and Phoebe Bridgers. Leon Thomas, Bruno Mars and Olivia Dean have six each, while Taylor Swift has five. Rock band Geese also has five in its first appearance on the ballot. Women claimed many of the top spots this year, at a ceremony where they have historically been underrepresented.
## The Nigerian angle
Nigerian stars are also in the mix, with Tems, Davido and Ayra Starr among those nominated, and Beyoncé reaching a record 100 career nominations.
## When and where
The 69th Grammy Awards will be held in Los Angeles on 7 February 2027, with 100 competitive categories.
more: Raye has 11 nominations, Rosalía nine.
Tems, Davido and Ayra Starr are also nominated.
The ceremony is on 7 February in Los Angeles.

stories.h: Makinde warns NURTW against taking over Oyo motor parks after seven-day ultimatum
stories.p: Oyo Governor Seyi Makinde has reportedly warned the NURTW not to forcibly take over motor parks. The union had given his government until 23 November to withdraw its Park Management System, citing court rulings.
body: Oyo State Governor Seyi Makinde has reportedly warned the National Union of Road Transport Workers (NURTW) not to take over public motor parks by force, after the union issued an ultimatum to his government.
## The ultimatum

On Sunday, the Oyo NURTW reportedly gave the government until 23 November to withdraw its Park Management System from parks across the state's 33 local government areas. The union said it would otherwise begin enforcing court judgments it says recognise its right to run the parks.

Its leaders, Abideen Olajide and Lekan Alesinloye, accused the administration of ignoring several rulings in the union's favour and said members had been excluded for seven and a half years. They said they had informed the federal government, the army, the DSS, the police and the Nigeria Labour Congress of their plans.
## The governor's response

In a statement issued on Monday through his special adviser on media, Dr Sulaimon Olanrewaju, Makinde said his government remained committed to the rule of law and urged residents to stay calm. He insisted the union would not be allowed to take over the parks.
## Background
The Makinde administration previously banned the NURTW in Oyo State and set up the Park Management System to run motor parks, a move that has been the subject of legal and political disputes since.
more: The union's deadline is 23 November.
Makinde says the government will uphold the rule of law.
Oyo previously banned the NURTW.

stories.h: Actress Linda Osifo gets engaged, shares proposal video
stories.p: Nollywood actress Linda Osifo has announced her engagement to her partner, Ose, sharing a video of the proposal. She thanked God for answering a private prayer.
body: Nollywood actress Linda Osifo has announced that she is engaged to her partner, identified as Mr Ose.
## The proposal
The actress shared a romantic video of the proposal on her social media page on Monday, 16 November 2026, and wrote an emotional message alongside it.
## What she said

Osifo said God had answered a prayer she once made quietly, adding that it came in his own time and not the way she had imagined. She described the love story as worth every season of waiting and told her fiancé she would choose him in every lifetime, ending with an excited declaration that she had said yes.
more: She shared a video of the proposal.
She called him the man she would choose in every lifetime.

stories.h: UEFA backs France's Philippe Diallo to challenge Infantino for FIFA presidency
stories.p: French federation president Philippe Diallo is set to run against Gianni Infantino in the March 2027 FIFA election after winning UEFA's backing. Infantino is seeking a fourth term.
body: French Football Federation president Philippe Diallo is reportedly set to challenge Gianni Infantino in the FIFA presidential election in March 2027, after winning the backing of European football's governing body, UEFA.
## What happened

Diallo, 63, was invited to stand at a UEFA meeting chaired by its president, Aleksander Čeferin, on Monday, 16 November 2026. UEFA said the associations on its executive committee and the FIFA Council had unanimously pledged their support. The French federation's executive committee is expected to formally approve his candidacy on Tuesday, a day before nominations close.
He is said to have emerged as UEFA's choice after Arsène Wenger, now FIFA's chief of global football development, declined to run.
## Why it matters

UEFA said its members had serious concerns about the direction of FIFA and called for better governance and closer work with member associations. Infantino, 56, is seeking a fourth term at the FIFA Congress in Rabat, Morocco, on 18 March 2027.
## Background

Infantino came under pressure this year over plans to sell stakes in the World Cup to private equity investors. UEFA threatened a boycott and the proposal was withdrawn. The French federation withdrew its support for him in September, and England, Wales and Scotland later withdrew their letters endorsing his re-election.
more: The election is on 18 March 2027 in Rabat.
Infantino is seeking a fourth term.
Arsène Wenger reportedly declined to run.
stories.credit: Stock image: Thecoolone1223 / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 4.0
stories.alt: MetLife Stadium in New Jersey, which hosted the 2026 World Cup final

stories.h: FG orders ministries and agencies to freeze staff numbers for 2027
stories.p: The federal government has reportedly told ministries, departments and agencies to keep their workforce at current levels in 2027. Agencies that ignore the new reporting rules risk losing budget provisions.
body: The federal government has reportedly directed all ministries, departments and agencies (MDAs) to keep their workforce at current levels for the 2027 fiscal year.
## The circular

The directive is contained in a circular dated 9 November 2026 from the Office of the Head of the Civil Service of the Federation, titled the 2027 Workforce Budget Call Circular. It was addressed to ministers, permanent secretaries, service chiefs and heads of federal institutions.
## The new rules

Under the circular, MDAs may not create new departments, units or other structures without clearance from the Head of Service. Every workforce budget proposal must include the institution's approved organisational structure, and no vacancies may be created in structures that have not been officially approved.

The government is said to have singled out posts on Grade Levels 15 to 17, the senior ranks of the federal civil service, warning agencies against creating unauthorised vacancies at those levels. Agencies that can show a genuine staffing need must back their requests with evidence.
## Penalties
Institutions that fail to comply with the new reporting requirements reportedly risk having their budget provisions cut off.
more: MDAs must keep staff numbers at current levels.
No new departments without Head of Service clearance.
Defaulters risk losing budget provisions.

stories.h: Kano Governor Abba Yusuf confirms divorce from Kwankwaso's daughter, says he will marry again
stories.p: Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf has reportedly confirmed that his marriage to Zainab Kwankwaso, daughter of his former political mentor Rabiu Kwankwaso, has ended. Speaking with humour at a pensioners' event, he said the dissolution papers had been issued and that he still intends to take another wife.
body: Kano State Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf has reportedly confirmed that his marriage to Zainab Musa Kwankwaso, the daughter of former Kano governor and NDC leader Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso, has ended.
## What the governor said

Yusuf is said to have spoken about the matter on Monday, 16 November 2026, while addressing pensioners at an event at the Government House in Kano. Speaking in Hausa and in a light-hearted tone, he compared going from two wives to one to a demotion in military rank, from corporal to constable.

He reportedly confirmed that he had agreed to the divorce and that the papers for the dissolution had been issued. He also told the gathering that he still plans to take another wife, and asked residents to pray that he finds a suitable partner. He said he was at peace with the decision.
## Background
The confirmation came two days after reports that Zainab Kwankwaso had filed a divorce petition at an Upper Area Court in Gudu, Abuja. She was said to be the governor's second wife.
The separation has drawn wide attention because of the long political relationship between Yusuf and Kwankwaso, who was his political mentor.
## Dalung's criticism

Former sports minister Solomon Dalung has criticised the governor over his public remarks on the divorce. He said a man does not need to humiliate the mother of his children to show that a marriage is over.
Reports say the governor told a gathering that the papers had been granted and joked that an advert would be placed for anyone wishing to fill the vacant position.
## The political backdrop

Yusuf won the Kano governorship on the NNPP platform with Kwankwaso's backing, but later defected to the APC. The political fallout between the two men, which began about a year ago, is said to have strained the marriage.
more: Yusuf says the dissolution papers have been issued.
Solomon Dalung says he should not have humiliated his wife publicly.
Yusuf left Kwankwaso's camp and joined the APC.

stories.h: Wike tells FCT campaign council not to let ADC or NDC reach 25% in Abuja
stories.p: FCT Minister Nyesom Wike has reportedly told the Tinubu campaign council and his Rainbow Coalition in Abuja that no opposition party should get 25 per cent of the vote in the territory in 2027. He said members would be held accountable for the result.
body: Federal Capital Territory Minister Nyesom Wike has reportedly directed President Bola Tinubu's campaign team in Abuja to make sure no opposition party wins up to 25 per cent of the votes in the territory at the 2027 elections.
## What happened

Wike gave the directive on Monday, 16 November 2026, while inaugurating a 466-member APC Presidential Campaign Council and Rainbow Coalition in Abuja. The coalition is said to also include members of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) who back the president.

He named the African Democratic Congress (ADC) and the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) as the main opposition parties the council should work against, saying they should not be allowed to reach 25 per cent. He reportedly said simply winning was not enough and that members would be held personally responsible for the outcome in the FCT.
## Why 25 per cent matters

Under the Constitution, a presidential candidate must win at least 25 per cent of votes in two-thirds of the states and the FCT to be declared winner on the first ballot, which makes the territory an important battleground.
## Jabs at opponents

Wike is also said to have dismissed claims that the ADC has strong support in the North or a real chance in the FCT, and challenged former Rivers governor Rotimi Amaechi to test his party's strength in Rivers State.
## The other side
No response from the ADC or NDC was included in the reports. The presidential election is scheduled for 16 January 2027.
more: Wike inaugurated a 466-member campaign council in Abuja.
He named the ADC and NDC as the parties to beat.
The FCT 25% rule is key in presidential elections.

stories.h: Gas explosion at Lagos filling station spreads fire to neighbouring school, no casualties
stories.p: A gas explosion at an NNPC filling station in Ejigbo, Lagos, on Sunday reportedly started a fire that spread to a school next door. Firefighters contained it and no one was hurt, as the school was closed for the weekend.
body: A gas explosion at an NNPC filling station at Savannah Bus Stop, Command, in the Ejigbo area of Lagos State reportedly caused a fire that spread to a neighbouring private school on Sunday, 15 November 2026.
## What happened

The explosion is said to have happened at about 1pm. The Controller-General of the Lagos State Fire and Rescue Service, Margaret Adeseye, confirmed the incident and said the force of the blast caused the fire to spread quickly to Saint Lawrence Greater Height School, which shares a boundary with the station, affecting parts of the premises.
## The response

Adeseye said the service received a distress call at 12:50pm and reached the scene at 1:13pm. Firefighters from the Ejigbo, Ikeja and Bolade fire stations were deployed, and they stopped the fire from spreading to other parts of the school.
## No casualties
No one was injured or killed, as the school was closed for the weekend. The fire service said preliminary investigations into the cause of the explosion were under way.
more: The fire spread to a school next to the station.
No one was hurt because the school was closed.
Investigations into the cause have begun.

stories.h: NDC vice-chairman and ward leaders in Kano's Bichi reportedly defect to APC
stories.p: The NDC vice-chairman in Bichi Local Government, Kano State, and executives of five wards have reportedly joined the APC. They cited the work of their federal lawmaker and complaints about how the NDC is run in Kano.
body: The Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) in Bichi Local Government Area of Kano State has reportedly lost several officials to the All Progressives Congress (APC).
## Who moved

The group was said to be led by the NDC vice-chairman in Bichi, Haladu Sa'adu, and included the party's local treasurer, the chairmen of five wards with their secretaries, and women and youth leaders, as well as some leaders of the Kwankwasiyya movement. They announced the move on Monday, 16 November 2026, during a visit to the office of Abubakar Kabir Abubakar Bichi, the APC lawmaker representing Bichi Federal Constituency and chairman of the House Committee on Appropriations.
## Their reasons

Speaking for the group, the Danzabuwa ward chairman reportedly praised the lawmaker's projects in the area, saying his scholarship programme had paid for his own postgraduate studies. He also complained of poor coordination and a lack of respect for ordinary members within the NDC in Kano.
## The APC welcome
The lawmaker welcomed the defectors and said their arrival would strengthen the APC at the grassroots in Bichi and Kano North.
## The other side
No response from the NDC leadership in Kano was included in the reports. Bichi is the same area where Rabiu Kwankwaso's convoy was reportedly attacked last week.
more: The group included five ward chairmen.
They cited their lawmaker's projects in Bichi.
No response from the NDC was included in reports.
stories.alt: Rabiu Kwankwaso speaking to the press

stories.h: Eric Chelle reportedly snaps at journalist over tactics ahead of Tanzania return leg
stories.p: Super Eagles coach Eric Chelle reportedly pushed back sharply at a journalist who questioned his formation and team selection before Tuesday's AFCON 2027 qualifier in Tanzania. Nigeria lead 3-1 from the first leg.
body: Super Eagles head coach Eric Chelle reportedly clashed with a journalist at a press conference in Tanzania on Monday, 16 November 2026, ahead of Nigeria's second-leg AFCON 2027 qualifier.
## What happened

The session is said to have become tense when a reporter questioned Chelle's formation and player selection. The coach reportedly responded firmly, drawing a line between his job and that of the media, and said his decisions are shaped by the players he has available and the opponents, not outside opinion. A video of the exchange was shared on X.
It is not the first time Chelle has had a heated exchange with Nigerian journalists over his choices.
## The match

Nigeria arrived in Tanzania on Sunday and held their final training session on Monday. The Super Eagles won the first leg 3-1 in Uyo, so a good result in the return leg in Zanzibar on Tuesday would put them firmly on course for the tournament.
## Injury worries
The team will be without Ademola Lookman, who has been ruled out for several weeks with an injury, while Victor Osimhen is also absent injured, leaving the attack short of two key players.
more: Nigeria lead Tanzania 3-1 from the first leg.
The return leg is on Tuesday in Zanzibar.
Lookman and Osimhen are both out injured.

stories.h: Police say 78 arrested over Tinubu convoy incident, now being released after presidential clemency
stories.p: The FCT Police Command says it arrested 78 people after the president's motorcade was reportedly pelted with stones in Garki, Abuja, on Friday. It says the suspects are now being warned and released after the Presidency extended clemency to them.
body: The Federal Capital Territory Police Command has reportedly said that 78 people were arrested in connection with an incident involving President Bola Tinubu's motorcade in Abuja last Friday, and that all of them are now being released on the Presidency's directive.
## What the police said

In a statement on Monday, 16 November 2026, the command's spokesperson, CSP Josephine Adeh, said the incident happened on Friday, 13 November, shortly after the President observed Friday prayers at a mosque in the Garki District. According to the police account, some people threw stones and other objects at the departing convoy, damaging several vehicles and injuring some security personnel.
The police said a joint security team responded at the scene and that later intelligence-led raids in the area brought the total number of people arrested to 78.
## Clemency and release
The statement said the Presidency had extended clemency to those involved and directed that the suspects be warned and released. The command said they were going through the release process.
## Earlier denial

The Presidency had earlier dismissed reports that the convoy was attacked, while some opposition figures, including former senator Dino Melaye, insisted the incident happened and shared videos online. The police statement is the first official account to describe arrests in connection with it.
## Call for calm

The FCT Commissioner of Police, CP Ahmed Mohammed Sanusi, warned against violence and destruction of property as campaigns for the 2027 general elections intensify. He urged political parties, politicians and their supporters to avoid intimidation and inflammatory statements, and directed area commanders and tactical units to step up security operations across the territory.

stories.h: Robert Pattinson reportedly named the new James Bond
stories.p: Robert Pattinson has reportedly been confirmed as the next James Bond, ending years of speculation over who would follow Daniel Craig. He is said to star in the upcoming 007 film directed by Denis Villeneuve.
body: British actor Robert Pattinson has reportedly been named the next James Bond, ending years of guessing over who would take over the role of the famous secret agent.
## The announcement

The franchise is said to have confirmed the casting on Monday, 16 November 2026, with a short video showing the 40-year-old actor in a black tuxedo, pointing a gun. Pattinson is best known for the Twilight films and for currently playing Bruce Wayne in DC's Batman films.
## The race for the role

Several actors, including Callum Turner, Nicholas Hoult, Jack Lowden and Josh O'Connor, were reportedly screen-tested before the casting was announced for the new film, which will be directed by Denis Villeneuve. In a recent magazine interview, Villeneuve spoke about the pressure of taking on the franchise and said casting was still in progress at the time.
## Background

Daniel Craig stepped down as 007 after five films over 15 years, ending with No Time to Die in October 2021. He was the sixth actor to play the character, after Sean Connery, George Lazenby, Roger Moore, Timothy Dalton and Pierce Brosnan. If confirmed, Pattinson would become the seventh actor to play Bond in the official film series.
## What happens next
No release date for the new Bond film was given in the reports.
more: Pattinson is best known for Twilight and The Batman.
Denis Villeneuve is directing the new film.
Daniel Craig left the role after No Time to Die in 2021.

stories.h: Beyoncé reportedly becomes first artist with 100 Grammy nominations
stories.p: Beyoncé's nomination for Best R&B Solo Performance at the 2027 Grammys reportedly takes her career total to 100, the most in Grammy history. Tems is among the artists nominated in the same category.
body: Beyoncé has reportedly become the first artist in history to receive 100 Grammy nominations, after picking up a new nod in the nominations for the 69th Annual Grammy Awards announced this week.
## The nomination

The singer is nominated for Best R&B Solo Performance for Morning Dew (Donk), a song she released as a surprise on 4 July 2026. A remix featuring her husband, Jay-Z, followed a month later. She faces Kehlani, Victoria Monét, Jill Scott and Nigeria's Tems in the category.
## A record career
Beyoncé was already the most-decorated artist in Grammy history, with 35 wins. Jay-Z is said to be close behind her on the all-time nominations list, now with 90.
## The Nigerian angle

Tems' place in the same category means Nigerian fans will be watching this race closely. She is one of several Nigerian stars recognised in this year's nominations, alongside Davido and Ayra Starr, who are nominated for Best Global Music Album.
## What happens next
Winners will be announced at the 2027 Grammy Awards ceremony early next year.
more: Her nomination is for Morning Dew (Donk).
Tems is nominated in the same category.
Jay-Z is reported to be second with 90 nominations.

stories.h: Atiku accuses Tinubu's camp of using AI to fake rally crowds, says Potiskum crowd was real
stories.p: Atiku Abubakar has reportedly accused the presidency of using artificial intelligence to create images of large crowds at its events. He said the crowd that welcomed him in Potiskum, Yobe State, was genuine.
body: Former Vice President and ADC presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar has reportedly accused President Bola Tinubu's administration of using artificial intelligence to produce images of crowds at political events, while insisting the turnout at his own rally in Potiskum, Yobe State, was real.
## What Atiku said

Atiku is said to have contrasted the welcome he received in Potiskum with what he described as doctored images released by the presidency, and mocked the quality of those images. He described the reception from the time his team entered Potiskum from Azare in Bauchi State as breathtaking, pointing to the size of the crowd and the chants from residents.
He said his campaign, which he calls the Affordable Life campaign, did not need artificial crowds, and that chants of "Tinubu Must Go" at his rallies reflected a real demand for change.
## Praise for Yobe governor
Atiku reportedly thanked the Yobe State governor for allowing a fair environment for his campaign, saying open political competition strengthens democracy.
## His promise
He pledged to act quickly on the cost of living if elected at the presidential election scheduled for 16 January 2027.
## The other side
The reports did not include a response from the presidency or the APC campaign to the AI claim.
more: Atiku says the Potiskum crowd was real.

stories.h: Osun government demotes two traditional rulers; one monarch claims APC sympathy was the reason
stories.p: Governor Ademola Adeleke has reportedly approved the downgrading of two Osun traditional stools from Part II to Part III chieftaincies. One of the affected monarchs says no reason was given and alleges the move was political.
body: The Osun State Government has reportedly stripped two traditional rulers of their Part II chieftaincy status, reducing their stools to minor chieftaincies in a decision approved by Governor Ademola Adeleke.
## What the government did

A letter from the state's Ministry of Local Government and Chieftaincy Affairs is said to show that the governor approved the de-recognition of the Alagunbelewo of Agunbelewo, Oba Maruf Lawal, and the Olu of Irepodun, Oba Adewale Adeniyi Sikiru, under the state's Chiefs Law. Both stools now revert to Part III, which means the rights, privileges and allowances attached to their former status have been withdrawn. The government reportedly said the approval would be published in the state gazette.
## The monarch's response

Oba Lawal reportedly said the affected rulers received letters without any official reason and questioned whether the decision had been ratified by the State Executive Council as the law requires. He alleged that the action may have been linked to perceived sympathy for the All Progressives Congress (APC).
He further claimed that the rulers had been expected to show loyalty to the governor's party in return for support they received. These claims have not been independently confirmed.
## What happens next
No response from the Osun government to the monarchs' allegations was included in the reports. The affected rulers say they want answers on the reasons for their demotion.
more: The two stools were moved from Part II to Part III.
One monarch says no reason was given.
He alleges the move was linked to APC sympathy.

stories.h: Linda Ejiofor wins Best Supporting Actress at 2026 AMAA
stories.p: Nollywood actress Linda Ejiofor won Best Actress in a Supporting Role at the 2026 Africa Movie Academy Awards for her role in The Herd. Her husband and colleagues have flooded her page with congratulations.
body: Nollywood actress Ihuoma Linda Ejiofor has won the award for Best Actress in a Supporting Role at the 2026 Africa Movie Academy Awards (AMAA).
## The win
The ceremony took place on Sunday, 15 November 2026, and Ejiofor was honoured for her performance in the film The Herd.
## How people reacted

After the announcement, her husband and many of her colleagues in the film industry went to the comment section of her social media page to congratulate her, and fans joined in with messages of praise and encouragement.

stories.h: Romelu Lukaku retires from international football with Belgium
stories.p: Belgium's all-time top scorer Romelu Lukaku has retired from international football at 33. He scored 94 goals in 135 appearances over 16 years.
body: Romelu Lukaku, Belgium's all-time record goalscorer, has announced his retirement from international football at the age of 33.
## The announcement

The former Chelsea and Manchester United striker made the announcement on Monday, 16 November 2026, a day after he was an unused substitute in Belgium's 4-1 Nations League win over Italy. He had missed the previous game, a 2-1 win over Turkey, with a hip injury. His last appearance for his country came in a 4-1 defeat to France last month.
## What he said

In his farewell message, Lukaku thanked his teammates, coaches and Belgian fans, and said he was proud to have played at four World Cups and three European Championships. He said he was at peace with his decision.
## His record
Lukaku, who now plays for Fenerbahce, made his Belgium debut in 2010 and finished with 94 goals in 135 matches, the most goals ever scored for the national team.
more: He scored 94 goals in 135 games for Belgium.
He played at four World Cups and three Euros.
He now plays club football for Fenerbahce.

stories.h: Nigeria's inflation reportedly eases to 14.06% in October; Imo highest, Taraba lowest
stories.p: Nigeria's headline inflation reportedly fell to 14.06% in October 2026. State figures show Imo with the highest annual rate at 28.66% and Taraba the lowest at 6.12%, while Ondo and Lagos topped food inflation.
body: Nigeria's headline inflation rate reportedly eased to 14.06% in October 2026, according to the latest figures from the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS), with wide differences in price increases across the states.
## Highest and lowest states

Imo recorded the highest annual headline inflation in October at 28.66%, followed by Enugu at 22.81% and Kaduna at 21.55%. At the other end, Taraba had the lowest rate at 6.12%, followed by Sokoto at 6.68% and Ekiti at 7.64%.
On a month-on-month basis, Bauchi, Borno and Yobe recorded the biggest increases, while Oyo, Osun and Akwa Ibom saw average prices fall compared with September.
## Food prices

Food inflation remained high in several states. Ondo had the highest annual food inflation rate at 31.74%, followed by Lagos at 31.43% and Imo at 29.75%. Nasarawa, Bayelsa and Kano recorded the lowest annual food inflation.
Month on month, Yobe, Kebbi and Borno saw the sharpest food price increases, while Lagos, Plateau and Benue recorded declines in average food prices compared with the previous month.
## Why it matters

The figures come as the cost of living remains a central issue in campaigns for the 2027 elections. The federal government recently announced new support for farmers, including a guaranteed minimum price scheme meant to give growers assured markets for their produce.
more: Imo had the highest annual rate at 28.66%.
Taraba had the lowest at 6.12%.
Ondo and Lagos topped food inflation.

stories.h: Davido, Tems and Ayra Starr all nominated for 2027 Grammy Best Global Music Album
stories.p: Davido's 'ORIADÉ', Tems' 'Love Is a Kingdom' and Ayra Starr's 'Starrgirl' are among the five nominees for Best Global Music Album at the 2027 Grammy Awards, alongside Anitta and Angélique Kidjo. The ceremony is on 7 February 2027.
body: Three Nigerian stars, Davido, Tems and Ayra Starr, have been nominated in the same category at the 2027 Grammy Awards.
## The nominees

The Recording Academy announced on Monday, 16 November 2026, that the nominees for Best Global Music Album are 'EQUILIBRIVM' by Brazilian star Anitta, 'ORIADÉ' by Davido, 'HOPE!!' by Beninese legend Angélique Kidjo, 'STARRGIRL' by Ayra Starr and 'LOVE IS A KINGDOM' by Tems. The 69th Grammy Awards will be held on 7 February 2027.
## Davido's album

'ORIADÉ', Davido's sixth studio album, was released on 31 July 2026 and marks his 15 years in music. The 13-track project was submitted in several categories, including Album of the Year, but received its nomination in the global music category. Davido has been nominated before, including for his album 'Timeless' and the songs 'Unavailable' and 'Feel' in 2024, but has yet to win.
## A strong year for Nigeria
## More nominations

Tems also picked up nominations for Best African Music Performance for 'Big Daddy', and Best R&B Solo Performance and Best R&B Song for 'What You Need'. Ayra Starr is nominated for Best African Music Performance for 'Aye Kan (Are You Coming Back?)', featuring Angélique Kidjo.

Tems, who has already won Grammys, is also executive music producer of the soundtrack for the Hollywood film 'Children of Blood and Bone', while Ayra Starr was recently announced for Coachella 2027. Kidjo is a five-time Grammy winner.
## Over to you
Davido, Tems or Ayra Starr: who do you think takes the Grammy home?
more: Three Nigerians are in the same Grammy category.

stories.h: FG seeks another $500 million World Bank loan to expand renewable energy programme
stories.p: The Federal Government is seeking an additional $500 million loan from the World Bank for its renewable energy programme, which would raise the World Bank's total financing for the project to $1.25 billion. Many Nigerians are asking where the results of earlier spending can be seen.
body: The Federal Government is seeking an additional $500 million loan from the World Bank to expand its renewable energy programme.
## What the money is for

The programme is meant to expand access to electricity through renewable sources such as solar mini-grids and stand-alone solar systems, particularly for homes, businesses, schools and health centres in areas the national grid does not reach.

In 2023, the World Bank approved $750 million for Nigeria's Distributed Access through Renewable Energy Scale-up (DARES) project, which aims to bring clean electricity to millions of Nigerians. The new $500 million would raise the World Bank's total financing for the project to $1.25 billion.
## "Where is the renewable energy?"
The news has been met with frustration by many Nigerians, who say they are yet to see the impact of the money already borrowed.

Millions of households and small businesses still depend on generators, while frequent grid collapses and rising electricity tariffs continue to bite. For many people, the question is simple: where is the renewable energy?
## The debt question

The request also comes amid growing concern about Nigeria's rising debt. Critics argue that new loans should only be taken when there is clear evidence that earlier funds have been well spent and are delivering results.
Supporters of the programme argue that renewable energy is essential for closing Nigeria's huge electricity gap, and that such projects take time to deliver.
## Over to you
Should the government borrow more for renewable energy, or show results from the money already borrowed first?
more: The FG is seeking an extra $500m World Bank loan.
It would take World Bank funding for the programme to $1.25bn.
Many Nigerians say they are yet to see the impact.

stories.h: Osita Iheme and I Go Save tell politicians: show us results, not dance moves
stories.p: Actor Osita Iheme and comedian I Go Save have criticised politicians who dance and show off their fitness at campaign rallies, saying Nigerians want competence, manifestos and results instead.
body: Two well-known entertainers have hit out at politicians who turn campaign rallies into dance shows ahead of the 2027 elections.
## Osita Iheme

In an Instagram post on Monday, 16 November 2026, Nollywood actor Osita Iheme, popularly known as Pawpaw, urged politicians to spend their energy demonstrating competence rather than choreography. He said Nigerians want results, vision and accountability from their leaders, not entertainment, and issued what read as a warning to politicians to take voters seriously.
## I Go Save

Comedian I Go Save also questioned why candidates increasingly run, jump and dance at public events instead of addressing national issues. He wondered whether the displays were meant to prove physical fitness or had become a new form of competition between candidates, and said they should present credible manifestos and practical ideas instead.
## Background
Other celebrities have recently used their platforms to criticise politicians over roads and governance. The presidential election is scheduled for 16 January 2027.
more: Osita Iheme wants competence, not choreography.
I Go Save questioned politicians' stage displays.
Both urged candidates to focus on issues.

stories.h: Pastor Ibiyeomie accuses fellow preachers of staying silent on Tinubu government
stories.p: Pastor David Ibiyeomie has accused many Nigerian preachers of keeping quiet about the Tinubu administration out of tribal loyalty and financial ties, contrasting it with how vocal they were under Goodluck Jonathan.
body: Pastor David Ibiyeomie has criticised fellow preachers over what he described as their silence on the Tinubu administration.
## What he said

In a sermon shared on Instagram on Sunday, 15 November 2026, Ibiyeomie argued that many clerics had gone quiet on pressing national issues, including poverty, the killing of Nigerians in South Africa and what he described as anti-Christian laws, because of tribal loyalty and financial compromise. He contrasted the outspokenness of many preachers during former President Goodluck Jonathan's government with their silence now.
## No money from government
The pastor said he had never accepted money from any government official and challenged anyone to prove otherwise, arguing that financial dependence on politicians is what silences preachers.
## Background

Ibiyeomie, based in Port Harcourt, recently dedicated a 120,000-seat cathedral attended by Bishop David Oyedepo, who has also warned politicians over insecurity. The sermon sparked significant debate online.
more: Ibiyeomie says preachers are silent on Tinubu.
He blamed tribalism and money.

stories.h: Chinese national and police escort killed in ambush in Bauchi
stories.p: Suspected terrorists have killed a Chinese national working on a drilling project and the police inspector escorting him in an ambush in Alkaleri, Bauchi State. Another man was also reportedly killed.
body: Suspected terrorists have killed a Chinese national and a police inspector in an attack in Bauchi State.
## What happened

According to security sources, the attack happened on Saturday, 14 November 2026, at Ruga village in Alkaleri Local Government Area. The Chinese national, who was reportedly working on core drilling in the area, was travelling in a company vehicle when it was ambushed. A police inspector from a mobile police unit, who was deployed as his escort, was also killed. A local source said the attackers killed another man in the village.
## Response

Troops of the Nigerian Army's 3 Division were informed of the attack late on Saturday night, and security sources said efforts were under way to track down the attackers and establish the circumstances of the ambush.
## Background
Atiku Abubakar's campaign was in Bauchi State over the weekend, and insecurity remains a key issue ahead of the 2027 elections.
more: A Chinese national was killed in the ambush.

stories.h: Opposition parties to sign unity pact in Abuja on 23 November
stories.p: Nigeria's main opposition parties will sign a joint commitment to democratic renewal at a summit in Abuja on 23 November, adopting a national covenant, a framework for opposition unity and a reform programme.
body: Nigeria's main opposition parties are set to sign a joint pact at a summit in Abuja on Monday, 23 November 2026.
## The plan

In a statement on Monday, 16 November 2026, signed by Salihu Lukman, the Coalition for Democracy said the Second Summit of Nigeria's Opposition Political Parties would take place at the NAF Conference Centre. Participating parties are expected to adopt three documents prepared by working groups over several months: a National Covenant for Democratic Renewal, a Framework for Opposition Unity and a National Reform Programme. Party leaders will then sign them. The coalition described the summit as a turning point in how the opposition coordinates ahead of the 2027 elections.
## Background

The event follows the first opposition leaders' summit, held at the Yar'Adua Centre in Abuja on 31 August 2026, convened by the G100 group with the House of Representatives minority caucus. Efforts to field a single opposition candidate against President Bola Tinubu have so far failed, with Atiku Abubakar, Peter Obi and Seyi Makinde all running, though the Atiku and Makinde camps are reportedly in talks. It is not clear whether the pact will include any agreement on candidates. The presidential election is scheduled for 16 January 2027.
more: The summit is on 23 November in Abuja.
Three reform documents will be signed.
It is unclear if candidates will be discussed.

stories.h: Atiku says Tinubu only came to Plateau when he needed votes
stories.p: ADC candidate Atiku Abubakar has criticised President Tinubu's visit to Plateau State, saying residents needed their president during killings and kidnappings, not at an election rally.
body: Former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar has criticised President Bola Tinubu over his recent campaign visit to Plateau State.
## What he said

In a statement issued from Potiskum, Yobe State, on Monday, 16 November 2026, by his campaign's director of strategic communication, Phrank Shaibu, Atiku said no campaign promise or appeal for forgiveness could make up for the President's absence when communities in Plateau were under attack. He said residents had needed the President at the height of killings and kidnappings, and accused him of using people's grief as a political tool by returning to seek votes.
## Atiku's campaign
Atiku, the presidential candidate of the African Democratic Congress (ADC), was in Yobe State to continue his 'affordable life' campaign, after launching the North-East leg in Bauchi on Saturday.
## Background

Tinubu's campaign says the government has launched a five-year defence plan and approved the recruitment of 28,000 soldiers and 50,000 police officers. Former Plateau governors Simon Lalong and Joshua Dariye recently endorsed the President. The Presidency had not responded to Atiku's statement at the time of writing.
more: Atiku criticised Tinubu's Plateau visit.
He spoke from Potiskum, Yobe State.
The Presidency has not responded.

stories.h: Court warns AGF Fagbemi of jail over detained Okuama community leaders
stories.p: A Federal High Court in Warri has warned Attorney-General Lateef Fagbemi that he faces imprisonment if he keeps defying an order to release detained leaders of the Okuama community in Delta State.
body: A Federal High Court in Warri, Delta State, has warned the Attorney-General of the Federation, Lateef Fagbemi, that he could be jailed for contempt over the continued detention of leaders of the Okuama community.
## The notice

The warning was contained in a formal notice of consequences of disobedience to a court order, issued on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, and reported on Sunday. It relates to an order made on 10 June 2026 by Justice Hyeladzira Nganjiwa directing the immediate release of the applicants, six community leaders who brought a fundamental rights case. The respondents include the federal government, the AGF and the armed forces.
## Background

Okuama, in Ughelli South Local Government Area of Delta State, was the scene of the killing of 17 soldiers in March 2024, after which the military carried out operations in the area and detained several community members. The AGF's office had not responded to the court notice at the time of writing.
more: The court warned the AGF of possible jail.

stories.h: Dangote Refinery cuts petrol gantry price by ₦51 to ₦1,159
stories.p: Dangote Refinery has reportedly cut its petrol gantry price by ₦51 to ₦1,159 per litre, its latest reduction, as depot owners also lower prices.
body: Dangote Refinery has reduced the price at which it sells petrol at its gantry by ₦51 per litre, according to reports on Monday, 16 November 2026.
## The new price

The new rate is ₦1,159 per litre, down from ₦1,210, a cut of about 4.2 per cent. The reduction gives marketers and filling station owners room to lower pump prices, although retail prices also depend on transport, distribution costs and each retailer's margins.
## Depot prices
Depot owners have also been cutting their prices. Market data from Friday showed several Lagos depots selling at about ₦1,185 per litre, with one of the larger operators cutting its price by ₦35.
## Background

Petrol prices have fallen steadily in recent days after the refinery moved to pricing linked to international petrol prices. NNPC cut its pump prices in Lagos to ₦1,289 per litre at the weekend, and MRS stations in Abuja reduced theirs to ₦1,399. Marketers have warned, however, that renewed tension between Iran and the United States could push global prices up again.

stories.h: NAFDAC halves product registration fees for small businesses
stories.p: NAFDAC has cut product registration fees by 50 per cent for small businesses with five or fewer employees, as part of six measures to reduce the cost and delay of regulatory approval.
body: The National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC) has cut product registration fees in half for small businesses.
## The announcement

Speaking at a SMEDAN–NAFDAC summit in Lagos, reported on Monday, 16 November 2026, NAFDAC Director-General Professor Mojisola Adeyeye said the reduction applies to businesses with five or fewer employees and is part of a package of six support measures. She said the aim was to bring more entrepreneurs into the formal economy and make locally made products more competitive at home and abroad.
## Addressing complaints

Adeyeye acknowledged that many small business owners see the agency as a source of high costs, long delays and difficult paperwork, and said the new measures were meant to address those concerns. She said many delays are caused by incomplete documents, poor labelling and facilities that are not ready for inspection, and urged business owners to engage with the agency before applying.
## Background

The move comes as the government rolls out other support schemes for small businesses, including free business registration with the Corporate Affairs Commission. Last week, NAFDAC uncovered a suspected illegal cosmetics operation at the Lagos Trade Fair Complex.
more: Fees are halved for firms with five or fewer staff.
Six support measures were announced.
The aim is to formalise small businesses.

stories.h: Kwara APC governorship rally in Offa reportedly turns violent over unpaid mobilisation funds
stories.p: An APC governorship rally in Offa, Kwara State, reportedly descended into chaos after claims that some participants were not paid the mobilisation allowances they had been promised. The incident has revived debate about paying crowds to attend political events.
body: A governorship campaign rally organised by the All Progressives Congress (APC) in Offa, Kwara State, has reportedly descended into chaos following claims that some participants were not paid the mobilisation allowances they had been promised.
## What reportedly happened

According to reports, the rally drew a large crowd of supporters to the streets of Offa. But tension rose when some of those who had turned up complained that they had not received the money they were allegedly promised for attending.
The situation reportedly turned violent as angry participants confronted organisers, disrupting the event.
The full details, including whether anyone was injured and how much money was involved, have not been independently confirmed, and the party has not publicly commented on the incident.
## The business of crowds
The incident shines a light on a practice many Nigerians already know about: paying people, often called "mobilisation", to attend political rallies.

Across parties, campaign organisers frequently provide transport, food, branded caps and T-shirts, and sometimes cash, to fill venues and create the impression of massive support. When those promises are not kept, frustration can quickly boil over.
It also raises a deeper question. If people have to be paid to attend, how much do the crowds at political rallies really tell us about genuine support?
## Over to you
Should people be paid to attend political rallies, or should campaigns rely only on supporters who come out of conviction?
more: The rally reportedly turned chaotic over unpaid allowances.

The party has not commented publicly.
