stories.h: Tinubu campaign unveils five-year defence plan: 28,000 soldiers, 50,000 police
stories.p: The APC presidential campaign says President Tinubu has launched a five-year defence plan, with approval to recruit 28,000 more soldiers and 50,000 police officers, new army divisions and training depots.
body: President Bola Tinubu's campaign has outlined a five-year strategic defence plan it says will guide efforts to tackle insecurity.
## What was announced

In a statement on Sunday, 15 November 2026, APC presidential campaign spokesperson Dele Alake said the plan brings together defence priorities, operational needs, capability development and spending to respond to threats including terrorism, banditry and kidnapping. The campaign said the government had approved the recruitment of 28,000 additional soldiers and 50,000 new police officers, created four new army divisions and approved two new army depots in Osogbo, Osun State, and Amasiri-Edda, Ebonyi State, each able to train up to 6,000 recruits at a time. It also pointed to a 700-unit barracks project in Ikere-Ekiti.
## Claims of progress

The campaign claimed that military operations over the past three years had killed more than 15,000 insurgents and bandits, and that over 130,000 Boko Haram fighters and their dependants had surrendered under the Operation Safe Corridor rehabilitation programme. These figures could not be independently verified.
## Background

Insecurity is one of the main issues in the 2027 campaign. ADC candidate Atiku Abubakar this week cited tracker data showing 638 people were killed in October, and recent attacks in Zamfara and Kano have heightened concern. The presidential election is scheduled for 16 January 2027.
more: 28,000 soldiers and 50,000 police are to be recruited.
Four new army divisions were created, the campaign says.
Its progress figures could not be verified.

stories.h: Obi hits back at Tinubu over Anambra erosion jibe, launches 'Record of Service' series
stories.p: Peter Obi has rejected President Tinubu's claim at a rally that he abandoned Anambra during its erosion crisis, saying he will publish a ten-day series on his record as governor and that 'facts outlast allegations'.
body: Peter Obi, the presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), has responded to President Bola Tinubu's criticism of his record as governor of Anambra State.
## Tinubu's claim

At a recent campaign rally, the President accused Obi of failing to tackle erosion in Anambra while governor, contrasting it with what he described as his own decisive action on coastal problems in Lagos. He also praised Akwa Ibom governor Umo Eno for tackling erosion in his state.
## Obi's response

Writing from the United States, where he said he had arrived for engagements in Washington DC, Obi rejected the accusation and said he would launch a ten-day series called 'Record of Service', documenting his interventions and achievements as governor. He said opponents who were uneasy about their own records were scrutinising his past, and that while no leader achieves every goal, his dedication was never in doubt. He said facts outlast allegations and records weigh more than rhetoric.
## Background

The exchange is one of the most direct confrontations between the two candidates so far. Obi's record in Anambra has also been questioned by others this month, including musician Seun Kuti. The presidential election is scheduled for 16 January 2027.
more: Tinubu said Obi neglected Anambra erosion.
Obi will publish a ten-day 'Record of Service'.
Obi is in the US for engagements.

stories.h: Ghanaian promoter upset after Davido reportedly performs under 30 minutes
stories.p: A Ghanaian hotel owner who hosted 'The Davido Experience' in Manso Akwasiso was filmed looking upset after the singer reportedly performed for less than 30 minutes, sparking debate about the booking.
body: Davido is at the centre of a debate in Ghana after reportedly performing for less than half an hour at a show there.
## What happened

The singer was the headline act at 'The Davido Experience' on Sunday, 15 November 2026, an event marking the third anniversary of a hotel in Manso Akwasiso owned by businessman Great Osama, whose real name is Kwaku Abonee. A video shared online appeared to show the businessman visibly upset after the short set, and another clip showed him apparently urging that the gates be kept shut as Davido prepared to leave.
## The fee

Some reports claimed the booking fee was around $600,000, but neither Davido, his management nor the organiser has confirmed the figure, and the terms of the agreement, including the agreed performance time, have not been made public.
## How people reacted

Reactions online were mixed, with some questioning the deal and others defending the singer. Davido had not publicly commented at the time of writing. He was also filmed warmly greeting Flavour in Ghana, a moment that sparked its own online debate.
more: Davido reportedly performed under 30 minutes.
The organiser appeared upset in a video.
The fee has not been confirmed.

stories.h: Peller and Jarvis reveal they are expecting a baby boy
stories.p: Streamers Peller and Jarvis have announced that they are expecting a baby boy, sharing an emotional gender-reveal video on Instagram in which they spoke of praying for the pregnancy.
body: Popular streamers and content creators Peller and Jarvis have revealed that they are expecting a baby boy.
## The announcement

In a video posted on Instagram on Sunday, 15 November 2026, the couple shared the gender of their first child and spoke about the emotional journey that led to the pregnancy, saying they had spent a long time praying and hoping. They addressed their unborn son directly, telling him how much he is already loved. Peller confirmed the news in the comments with 'Team Boy'.
## How people reacted
Fellow content creators and celebrities flooded the comments with congratulations.
## Background

Peller, whose real name is Habeeb Adelaja, is one of Nigeria's biggest TikTok live streamers, and Jarvis is also a well-known content creator. Peller was also recently nominated for Best International Streamer at the 2026 Streamer Awards.
more: Peller and Jarvis are expecting a boy.
They shared an emotional reveal video.
It will be their first child.

stories.h: Aremu Afolayan reportedly slaps Isbae U on 'Curiosity Made Me Ask'
stories.p: Actor Aremu Afolayan reportedly slapped comedian Isbae U and tore his clothes during a tense episode of Isbae U's interview show 'Curiosity Made Me Ask', after the host mocked him in his opening remarks.
body: A recent episode of comedian Isbae U's interview show 'Curiosity Made Me Ask' took a dramatic turn when actor Aremu Afolayan reportedly slapped the host and tore his clothes on camera.
## What happened

In the episode, reported on Monday, 16 November 2026, Isbae U opened with his usual provocative introduction, questioning whether Aremu could really be called an actor while acknowledging the greatness of his late father, filmmaker Adeyemi Afolayan. He also made jokes about the actor's physique and questioned his source of income. Aremu reportedly reacted angrily, slapping the host and tearing his clothes.
## How people reacted
The clip spread widely online. Neither man had publicly explained the incident at the time of writing.
## Background
'Curiosity Made Me Ask' is one of Nigeria's most popular celebrity interview shows, known for its sharp, teasing introductions. Aremu Afolayan is a member of the famous Afolayan film family.
more: Aremu reportedly slapped Isbae U on camera.
The host had mocked him in his introduction.
Some viewers wondered if it was staged.

stories.h: Suspected thugs attack Kwankwaso's convoy in Kano, smash about seven vehicles
stories.p: Suspected thugs reportedly attacked the campaign convoy of NDC vice-presidential candidate Rabiu Kwankwaso and Kano governorship candidate Aminu Abdussalam Gwarzo in Bichi on Sunday evening, injuring team members and damaging about seven vehicles.
body: The campaign convoy of Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso, the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) vice-presidential candidate and former Kano governor, was reportedly attacked by suspected thugs in Kano State on Sunday evening, 15 November 2026.
## What happened

According to Ibrahim Garba Shu'aibu, spokesperson for the NDC's Kano governorship candidate, Aminu Abdussalam Gwarzo, the convoy had passed peacefully through Tofa, Rimin Gado, Kabo, Gwarzo, Shanono and Bagwai local government areas before reaching Bichi. He said the team was warned that its route into Bichi had been blocked by people opposed to the rally, and that stones were thrown when the delegation arrived. The meeting went ahead, but as the convoy left, a group of armed youths near the local government secretariat reportedly attacked it, injuring some members of the team and smashing about seven vehicles. A media aide to Kwankwaso also confirmed the incident on social media.
## Response
The police had not publicly commented on the incident at the time of writing, and it is not clear who was behind the attack.
## Obi demands arrests

NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi described the attack as unacceptable and called on the police and other security agencies to investigate immediately, identify those responsible and prosecute them, including anyone who funded or organised the assault. He said political disagreements are no excuse for violence and that every Nigerian has the right to take part in the democratic process without fear.
## Background

The attack is the latest in a series of incidents of political violence ahead of the 2027 elections. Suspected thugs stormed an NDC town hall in Lagos last week, and supporters of other parties, including the APC, have also been attacked at rallies in several states. President Bola Tinubu has ordered security agencies to deal firmly with thuggery, and the House of Representatives is investigating attacks on political events. The presidential election is scheduled for 16 January 2027.
more: About seven vehicles were reportedly damaged.
Some campaign members were injured.
Police have not commented.

stories.h: Soludo tells politicians to keep campaigns out of churches
stories.p: Anambra governor Charles Soludo has urged politicians not to turn places of worship into campaign grounds, saying churches should be neutral spaces where people of all political views can worship in peace.
body: Anambra State governor Charles Soludo has called on politicians to stop turning churches into campaign platforms.
## What he said

Speaking at the 30th ministry anniversary of Prophet Chukwuemeka Ohanaemere, popularly known as Odumeje, in Onitsha, reported on Monday, 16 November 2026, Soludo said places of worship should be holy places where people of all political persuasions can worship God in peace. He said politicians have their own venues for politics and urged them to keep the two clearly separate. The governor said he had personally followed a policy of not using religious venues for campaigning.
## Background

Earlier this month, a Catholic priest apologised for singing Peter Obi's campaign song in church, and Yoruba Muslim clerics said they would not endorse any candidate. Soludo, whose party APGA has endorsed President Bola Tinubu for 2027, has pledged to deliver half of Anambra's votes to the President.
more: Soludo says churches are not for politics.
He spoke at an Onitsha church anniversary.
He says he avoids campaigning in churches.

stories.h: Zamfara police rescue 19 women and children after 22 days with bandits
stories.p: Zamfara police say they have rescued 19 women and children who had been held by bandits for 22 days, after a joint operation with the DSS and local hunters near Gusau. All were found unharmed.
body: Police in Zamfara State say they have rescued 19 women and children who had spent 22 days in the hands of bandits.
## The rescue

In a statement, police spokesperson DSP Yazid Abubakar said the victims had been abducted from Tungar Haki village in Gusau Local Government Area and taken to a bandits' hideout near Kungurmi village. They were rescued on Saturday, 14 November 2026, in a coordinated operation involving the police anti-kidnapping unit, officers attached to Government House, the Department of State Services and local hunters, following intelligence about their location.
## Reunited
The police said all 19 victims were found unharmed and have been reunited with their families.
## Background

Zamfara is one of the states worst affected by banditry and kidnapping for ransom. On Sunday, bandits killed a senior aide to the state governor during an attack in Kaura Namoda and reportedly abducted several worshippers.
more: 19 women and children were rescued.
They spent 22 days in captivity.
All were found unharmed.

stories.h: Guinea deports 1,557 West Africans convicted of illegal gold mining
stories.p: Guinea has deported 1,557 West Africans, mostly from Burkina Faso and Mali, who had been jailed for illegal gold mining, as it steps up a crackdown on unauthorised mining.
body: Guinea has expelled 1,557 West African nationals who were arrested and convicted for illegal gold mining.
## The deportation

According to judicial and security sources quoted in reports on Sunday, 15 November 2026, the deportees, mostly citizens of Burkina Faso and Mali, were arrested at mining sites during security operations. After serving prison sentences of 18 months to two years, they were taken in a convoy of 44 vehicles from the capital, Conakry, to the border town of Kouremale on the Mali border, arriving on Saturday.
## The crackdown

Guinean authorities stepped up operations against illegal mining in early November, particularly in Siguiri, a major gold-producing region in the north-east. The government says the aim is to stop illegal exploitation of mineral resources and limit environmental damage from unregulated mining.
## Background
The crackdown has also raised tensions between miners and the authorities.
more: 1,557 people were deported.
Most were from Burkina Faso and Mali.
They had served jail terms for illegal mining.

stories.h: Goodluck Jonathan calls for review of Nigeria's democracy and institutions
stories.p: Former President Goodluck Jonathan has called for a broad review of Nigeria's democratic structures, how politicians are recruited and the state of public institutions, saying the country owes a debt to its founding nationalists.
body: Former President Goodluck Jonathan has called for a wide-ranging review of Nigeria's democratic structures, political recruitment and public institutions.
## What he said

Chairing a colloquium at the Nigerian Institute of International Affairs in Lagos to mark the 162nd birth anniversary of nationalist Herbert Macaulay, reported on Sunday, 15 November 2026, Jonathan said the country's founding nationalists did not merely fight to end colonial rule, but imagined a sovereign, united and prosperous Nigeria where every citizen would enjoy equal rights, dignity and opportunity. He said independence was also meant to bring economic freedom, industrialisation, quality education, healthcare and social justice.
## Honesty about failures

While acknowledging progress in some areas, Jonathan said true patriotism requires honesty about the country's failures. He pointed to leadership failures and weak institutions, and urged a review of how the country's democracy works and how leaders emerge.
## Background

Jonathan, who governed from 2010 to 2015, is widely remembered for conceding defeat to Muhammadu Buhari in the 2015 election, a first for a sitting Nigerian president. The presidential election is scheduled for 16 January 2027.
more: Jonathan wants a review of Nigeria's democracy.
He spoke at an event honouring Herbert Macaulay.
He urged honesty about national failures.

stories.h: Yul Edochie and Judy Austin announce fourth child as May Edochie releases gospel song
stories.p: Actor Yul Edochie and his second wife Judy Austin have revealed they are expecting their fourth child together, on the same day his first wife May Edochie released a gospel single, 'Sorom', about overcoming her enemies.
body: Nollywood actor Yul Edochie and his second wife, Judy Austin, have announced that they are expecting their fourth child together.
## The announcement

The couple revealed the pregnancy in a new skit shared on Sunday, 15 November 2026, confirming rumours that had been circulating online. They already have three children together, and Judy has children from previous relationships. The news drew a flood of comments online, ranging from humour to disapproval.
## May's new song

On the same day, Yul's first wife, May Edochie, released a gospel single titled 'Sorom', recorded with an artist called Nwando, on major streaming platforms. Announcing it on Instagram, she said there was a good reason for releasing it that day and described God as always being with her and never letting her enemies triumph over her. The lyrics draw on biblical imagery about escaping a snare and finding joy.
## Background

Yul's public relationship with Judy Austin and his separation from May, with whom he has children, have been among the most talked-about celebrity stories in Nigeria in recent years. The couple's daughter was recently in the news for buying her first car.
more: Yul and Judy are expecting their fourth child.
May Edochie released a gospel song the same day.
Reactions online were mixed.

stories.h: Yoruba Muslim clerics' league says it will not endorse any 2027 candidate
stories.p: The League of Imams and Alfas in Yorubaland says it will not back any politician or party in the 2027 elections, insisting its role is to pray for Nigeria and guide the people, not to campaign.
body: The League of Imams and Alfas in Yorubaland has declared that it will not endorse any politician or party ahead of the 2027 elections.
## What the clerics said

At a gathering in Ibadan on Saturday, 14 November 2026, the chairman of the league's board of trustees, Sheikh Muhammad Habibullah Adam-Abdullahi El-Ilory, said the league had neither the capacity nor the intention to name a preferred candidate for any office. He said Islamic clerics are not politicians and their duty does not include campaigning for any individual or party. League president Sheikh Jamiu Kewulere said imams must stay focused on religious guidance.
## Background

The statement came after Oyo governor and APM presidential candidate Seyi Makinde made a donation to the league. The lecturers' union ASUU also said this week that it would not endorse any candidate. The presidential election is scheduled for 16 January 2027.
more: The league will not endorse any candidate.
It says clerics are not politicians.
Its stance follows a donation by Makinde.

stories.h: Jordan sentences three men to death over deadly church attack
stories.p: A Jordanian court has sentenced three men to death for a gun attack on a Greek Orthodox church funeral in October that killed nine people and wounded 25.
body: A court in Jordan has sentenced three men to death by hanging for a deadly attack on a church in the south of the country.
## The verdict

The State Security Court on Sunday, 15 November 2026, found the men, two brothers and a relative by marriage, guilty of terrorist attacks resulting in death, weapons offences, conspiracy to commit terrorist acts and promoting the ideas of a terrorist organisation, according to a statement from the Jordanian military.
## The attack

Gunmen killed nine people and wounded 25 when they stormed a funeral at a Greek Orthodox church in Hammoud village, in the Karak governorate, on 23 October 2026. The three suspects fled after the attack and were arrested three days later.
## Background
The attack shocked Jordan, a Muslim-majority country where Christians make up around three per cent of the population.
more: Three men were sentenced to death.
Nine people died in the October attack.
Christians are about 3% of Jordan's population.

stories.h: All 36 state assemblies approve state police bill, says National Assembly clerk
stories.p: The Clerk to the National Assembly says all 36 state Houses of Assembly have now approved the constitutional amendment creating state police, well above the 24 required. The bill is set to be sent to President Tinubu for assent.
body: The constitutional amendment to create state police in Nigeria has cleared a major hurdle, with 32 state Houses of Assembly approving it.
## What the Senate said

Senate Leader Opeyemi Bamidele said in Abuja on Sunday, 15 November 2026, that 32 state assemblies had approved the State Police (Constitution Alteration) Bill, 2026, which is more than the two-thirds required under Section 9(2) of the 1999 Constitution. He gave the remaining four assemblies until Tuesday, 17 November, to submit their reports, but said the National Assembly now has a duty to send the bill to President Bola Tinubu for assent whether or not they meet the deadline.
## All 36 states on board

On Monday, 16 November, the Clerk to the National Assembly, Kamoru Ogunlana, said all 36 state assemblies had approved the bill, describing it as a 100 per cent endorsement. Only 24 approvals are needed under Section 9(2) of the Constitution.

He said the bill had already met the legal requirements for transmission, but the National Assembly leadership had briefly held it back to allow for wider consensus with all the states. With verification now complete, he said, the bill will be sent to the President for assent.
## What the bill would do
The amendment would replace Nigeria's single, centralised police force with a Federal Police Service and State Police Services, allowing states to set up their own forces.
## Background

Calls for state police have grown stronger in recent years amid security threats including banditry and kidnapping. The senior civil servants' union this week also called for state police to be created.
more: All 36 state assemblies have approved the bill.
Only 24 approvals were required.
The bill now goes to President Tinubu for assent.

stories.h: NNPC gets land title for new Oredo refinery in Edo State
stories.p: NNPC has received a Certificate of Occupancy for its proposed Oredo Refinery and Petrochemical Company in Edo State, a step towards building a new refinery to boost local fuel production.
body: The Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPC) has taken a step towards building a new refinery in Edo State.
## The approval

NNPC's Executive Vice President for Downstream, Mumuni Dagazau, received the Certificate of Occupancy for the proposed Oredo Refinery and Petrochemical Company Limited during a courtesy visit to Governor Monday Okpebholo at the Edo State Government House in Benin City on Friday, 13 November 2026. He thanked the governor for providing the land and documents, and said the project would help increase local refining capacity, reduce dependence on imported fuel and strengthen energy security.
## Background

Nigeria's refining landscape has been transformed by the 650,000-barrel-per-day Dangote Refinery in Lagos, whose fuel exports to the United Kingdom have now overtaken crude oil sales, according to UK trade figures. No cost, capacity or timeline for the Oredo refinery was announced.
more: NNPC received the land title for the Oredo refinery.
It aims to boost local refining.
No cost or timeline was announced.

stories.h: UK now buys more refined fuel than crude oil from Nigeria, data shows
stories.p: UK trade figures show Britain bought £1.02 billion of refined petroleum products from Nigeria in the year to June 2026, more than double the year before, overtaking crude oil imports, as Dangote Refinery expands exports.
body: Nigeria's petroleum trade with the United Kingdom has shifted sharply towards refined fuel, according to UK government figures.
## The figures

The UK's trade and investment factsheet, released on 6 November 2026 and reported this weekend, shows Britain bought £1.02 billion worth of refined petroleum products from Nigeria in the 12 months to June 2026. That was more than double the figure a year earlier and made up 53.5 per cent of all UK goods imports from Nigeria. Over the same period, UK purchases of Nigerian crude oil fell by 56.2 per cent to £550.3 million, meaning refined fuel exports exceeded crude shipments by about £467 million. Nigeria recorded a petroleum trade surplus of about £245 million with Britain.
## Why it matters
The change reflects the growth of the Dangote Petroleum Refinery in Lagos, which can process 650,000 barrels a day and has been expanding its exports.
## Background
The government has also announced plans for a new NNPC refinery in Edo State.
more: UK bought £1.02bn of Nigerian refined fuel.
Crude oil purchases fell by 56%.
The shift reflects Dangote Refinery's exports.

stories.h: FG plans 24-hour electricity pilot for Lagos, Ogun and Abuja
stories.p: Power Minister Joseph Tegbe says the Lagos–Ogun axis and the Abuja distribution area have been chosen for a pilot scheme to provide 24-hour electricity, but no start date has been set.
body: The federal government says it plans to pilot round-the-clock electricity supply in parts of Lagos, Ogun and Abuja.
## What the minister said

Speaking at a luncheon with senior media editors in Lagos on Friday, 13 November 2026, Minister of Power Joseph Tegbe said the Lagos–Ogun axis and the Abuja electricity distribution franchise area had been selected for the proposed 24-hour supply pilot. He said the areas account for more than half of Nigeria's electricity demand, and that the scheme would focus on economic centres where reliable power could boost industry and reduce dependence on costly generators.
## Conditions
The minister said implementation would depend on technical readiness and commercial viability, and no start date was announced.
## Background

NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi this week promised 10,000 megawatts within four years, while a cleric called on the minister to resign over the power situation. Another state has separately announced a target of 24-hour power by 2029.
more: The pilot covers Lagos, Ogun and Abuja.
These areas are over half of national demand.
No start date has been announced.

stories.h: Temi Otedola and Mr Eazi welcome their first child
stories.p: Temi Otedola and singer Mr Eazi have welcomed their first child, with Temi sharing a photo of tiny knitted baby socks on Instagram. The couple married in Iceland in August 2025.
body: Actress and fashion entrepreneur Temi Otedola and her husband, singer Mr Eazi, have welcomed their first child.
## The announcement

Temi shared the news on Instagram on Sunday, 15 November 2026, posting a photo of a pair of cream knitted baby socks with a small bow and a caption counting their blessings. The couple did not immediately reveal the baby's name or sex.
## Their story

The couple announced in May that they were expecting their first child. Temi, the daughter of billionaire businessman Femi Otedola, and Mr Eazi, whose real name is Oluwatosin Ajibade, got engaged in April 2022 after dating for about four years. They married in August 2025 at Hallgrímskirkja church in Reykjavík, Iceland. Temi also recently shared a message marking their marriage milestone, which drew a sweet reaction from her husband.
## Background
Mr Eazi is a singer and music entrepreneur, while Temi has acted in films including 'Citation'.
more: The couple welcomed their first child.
Temi shared a photo of baby socks.
They married in Iceland in 2025.

stories.h: NNPC cuts petrol prices in Lagos, Abuja, Kaduna and Sokoto
stories.p: NNPC has reportedly cut pump prices at its outlets in Lagos, Abuja, Kaduna and Sokoto by between ₦52 and ₦66 per litre, with Lagos now at ₦1,289, the lowest of the four.
body: The Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPC) has reduced petrol pump prices at its retail stations in four cities, according to its latest price sheet reported on Sunday, 15 November 2026.
## The new prices

In Lagos, the price fell by ₦61, from ₦1,350 to ₦1,289 per litre, the lowest of the four locations. In Abuja it dropped by ₦55, from ₦1,380 to ₦1,325. Kaduna motorists will now pay ₦1,329, down ₦52 from ₦1,381, while Sokoto saw the biggest cut, ₦66, with the price falling from ₦1,378 to ₦1,312.
## Why prices are falling

The cuts follow a series of reductions in wholesale depot prices and Dangote Refinery's switch to pricing linked to international petrol prices, which reportedly brought its loading price down to ₦1,250 per litre. MRS stations and depot owners have also lowered their prices in recent days.
## Background
A recent comparison listed Nigeria among the countries with the cheapest petrol in West Africa.
more: Lagos is now ₦1,289 per litre at NNPC stations.
Cuts range from ₦52 to ₦66.
Depot and Dangote prices have also fallen.

stories.h: Bandits kill Zamfara governor's aide during dawn attack in Kaura Namoda
stories.p: Bandits have killed Nasiru Sani Kaura, a senior special assistant to Zamfara governor Dauda Lawal, during an attack on worshippers gathered for early morning prayers in Kaura Namoda. Several others were reportedly abducted.
body: Suspected bandits have killed a senior aide to Zamfara State governor Dauda Lawal during an early morning attack in Kaura Namoda.
## What happened

According to reports, the attack happened on Sunday, 15 November 2026, in the Low Cost area of Kaura Namoda town, as residents gathered for the dawn prayer. The gunmen killed Nasiru Sani Kaura, the governor's senior special assistant, and reportedly abducted several worshippers. Residents said the attackers fired indiscriminately and drove people from their homes.
## Who he was
Kaura was described as a grassroots politician and community leader, and his death has left the town in mourning. He was buried according to Islamic rites.
## Background

Zamfara is one of the states worst hit by banditry and kidnapping in the North-West. The attack came days after the DSS intercepted a large consignment of weapons allegedly being smuggled from Niger Republic to bandits in neighbouring Sokoto State. The police had not issued a statement at the time of writing, and it is not clear how many people were abducted.
more: Nasiru Sani Kaura was killed in the attack.
Several worshippers were reportedly abducted.
The attack happened during dawn prayers.

stories.h: Tinubu and Aregbesola have met three times since their rift, says APC chieftain
stories.p: Professor Sola Adeyeye, an APC campaign director in the South-West, says President Tinubu and former Osun governor Rauf Aregbesola have met at least three times since their political falling-out, and that he has tried to reconcile them.
body: President Bola Tinubu and his former close ally Rauf Aregbesola have met at least three times since their political falling-out, according to a senior figure in the ruling party.
## What he said

Professor Sola Adeyeye, director of electioneering planning for the All Progressives Congress (APC) presidential campaign in the South-West, said in an interview reported on Sunday, 15 November 2026, that he knew the two men had met about three times since the rift began. He described them as former very close friends, said the hurt is deeper when people who care about each other feel betrayed, and suggested time could heal the relationship. He said he had personally tried to broker a reconciliation but did not give details.
## Background

Aregbesola, a former Osun governor and minister, was one of Tinubu's closest political allies for decades before they fell out. He is now national secretary of the Mark-led faction of the African Democratic Congress (ADC), whose leadership was voided by a Federal High Court this month, a ruling the party has appealed. Aregbesola has not commented on Adeyeye's claim.
more: Adeyeye says the two have met three times.
He says he has tried to reconcile them.
Aregbesola has not commented.

stories.h: IGP Disu surprises his orderly by attending his wedding in Abia
stories.p: Inspector-General of Police Olatunji Disu travelled to Abia State to attend the traditional wedding of his orderly, a gesture that drew praise online.
body: The Inspector-General of Police, Olatunji Disu, has won praise after attending the traditional wedding of his orderly in Abia State.
## The wedding

Disu attended the ceremony on Saturday, 14 November 2026, at the family compound of a traditional ruler in Ukwu West Local Government Area, where his orderly, Victor Nnah Sunday, married his bride in a colourful ceremony rooted in Igbo tradition. Family members, friends and well-wishers gathered for the celebration.
## Why it drew attention

Many social media users praised the police chief for travelling to celebrate with a junior officer, seeing it as a sign of good leadership and of the relationship between him and those who serve closest to him. Some also noted that the Yoruba police chief had travelled to the South-East for the occasion.
## Background
This week he warned officers not to allow politicians to use them during the 2027 elections.
more: Disu attended his orderly's wedding in Abia.
The gesture drew praise online.
He recently warned officers against partisanship.

stories.h: Toyin Abraham steps in to stop her police escorts roughing up area boys
stories.p: A video shows actress Toyin Abraham intervening on a Lagos street to stop her police escorts from manhandling a group of area boys, calming the situation.
body: Nollywood actress Toyin Abraham has drawn attention after a video showed her stepping in to stop her police escorts from roughing up a group of young men on a Lagos street.
## What happened

In the footage, which spread on X after the incident on Saturday, 14 November 2026, the actress walks into a crowded scene involving the young men and onlookers and calmly but firmly tells her escorts to back off. The situation quickly calmed down after her intervention.
## The context

The encounter reportedly happened during a film production. Groups of area boys, often called agberos, are known to approach film crews shooting in public places in Lagos and demand payment before allowing work to continue, which can lead to tense confrontations.
## How people reacted

Many social media users praised the actress for preventing the situation from escalating, while others debated the use of police escorts by celebrities. The police recently opened an investigation after a video showed officers escorting businessman Blord.
more: Toyin Abraham told her escorts to back off.
The situation calmed down quickly.
Agberos often demand money from film crews.

stories.h: Lagos says construction of Epe International Airport will start in 2027
stories.p: Lagos State says work on the proposed Epe International Airport will begin in 2027, with Governor Sanwo-Olu announcing the timeline at an APC campaign event in Epe and his deputy saying preliminary work is well advanced.
body: The Lagos State Government plans to begin construction of the proposed Epe International Airport in 2027.
## The announcement

According to a statement by the Lagos chapter of the All Progressives Congress (APC), reported on Sunday, 15 November 2026, Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu announced the timeline at an APC governorship campaign event in Epe. His deputy, Dr Obafemi Hamzat, said significant progress had been made on the documentation and groundwork needed for the project.
## What it could mean

Lagos APC spokesman Seye Oladejo described the airport as a major infrastructure investment that could turn Epe into an important aviation, industrial and commercial hub, and said it would create opportunities for residents and businesses along the Lekki–Epe corridor.
## Background

Lagos is currently served by Murtala Muhammed International Airport in Ikeja, which handles most of Nigeria's international air traffic. The Lekki–Epe corridor has seen rapid development in recent years, including the Dangote Refinery and the Lekki Deep Sea Port. No cost or funding details were given in the latest announcement.
more: Construction is due to start in 2027.
The airport will be in Epe, on the Lekki corridor.
No cost details were given.

stories.h: Floyd Mayweather trains in Abuja as he launches Nigerian boxing programme
stories.p: Unbeaten boxing legend Floyd Mayweather has been training in Abuja after arriving to launch the TMT Frontrow Fight Series, a programme to develop young Nigerian boxers, ahead of his exhibition fight in Bangkok in December.
body: American boxing legend Floyd Mayweather has been spotted training in Abuja during a visit to Nigeria.
## Why he is in Nigeria

Mayweather arrived in the capital on Thursday, 13 November 2026, ahead of a press conference the next day to launch the TMT Frontrow Fight Series, a programme designed to give young Nigerian boxers access to professional coaching, international exposure and competitive fights. Organisers say boxing academies will be set up in Lagos, Abuja, Enugu, Calabar and other cities, and the first event in the series is planned for 2027.
## Training for Bangkok
Videos of the 49-year-old training in Abuja delighted fans online. He is preparing for an exhibition bout against Australian light-heavyweight Matt Floyd in Bangkok, Thailand, on 19 December 2026.
## Background
Mayweather retired from professional boxing in 2017 with an unbeaten record of 50 wins, 27 of them by knockout.
more: Mayweather is launching a boxing programme in Nigeria.
Academies are planned in Lagos, Abuja and other cities.
He fights an exhibition in Bangkok on 19 December.

stories.h: Late banker Herbert Wigwe's daughter Tochi weds in star-studded Lagos ceremony
stories.p: Tochi Wigwe, eldest daughter of the late Access Holdings chief Herbert Wigwe, has married investment professional Wilson Aikhomu in a traditional ceremony in Lagos attended by Osinbajo, Sanwo-Olu, Dangote and the Emir of Kano, with performances by Davido and Flavour.
body: Otutochi 'Tochi' Wigwe, the eldest daughter of the late banker Herbert Wigwe, has married her partner, Wilson Omogbale Aikhomu, in a traditional ceremony in Lagos.
## The ceremony

The wedding on Saturday, 14 November 2026, drew prominent guests including former Vice-President Yemi Osinbajo, Lagos governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu, businessman Aliko Dangote, the Emir of Kano Muhammadu Sanusi II, banker Aigboje Aig-Imoukhuede and Seyi Tinubu. Davido and Flavour performed for guests.
## The couple

The groom is a Lagos-based investment professional and managing partner of an investment firm. He is the son of the late Rear Admiral Joseph Aikhomu and a nephew of former Chief of General Staff Admiral Augustus Aikhomu, and was a close friend of Tochi's late brother, Chizi. Tochi, 28, leads her late father's non-profit organisation.
## Background
Herbert Wigwe, chief executive of Access Holdings, died in a helicopter crash in California in February 2024 alongside his wife, Chizoba, and son, Chizi.

stories.h: Atiku and Makinde camps reportedly hold alliance talks ahead of 2027
stories.p: Representatives of ADC candidate Atiku Abubakar and APM candidate Seyi Makinde have reportedly held a series of meetings, with sources in both camps saying an alliance before the 16 January election looks increasingly likely.
body: Representatives of former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar and Oyo State governor Seyi Makinde have reportedly been meeting to discuss a possible alliance ahead of the 2027 presidential election.
## The talks

According to reports on Sunday, 15 November 2026, sources from both camps say the prospect of an alliance is looking increasingly likely. An ADC leader in the South-West, speaking anonymously, described the discussions as fresh, purposeful and promising, and suggested an announcement would come before the 16 January election. The talks are said to be separate from wider opposition efforts to agree on a single candidate. Neither Atiku nor Makinde has publicly confirmed any deal.
## Background

Atiku is the candidate of the African Democratic Congress (ADC), while Makinde is running on the platform of the Allied Peoples Movement (APM). Makinde hosted an opposition summit in Ibadan in April to discuss a joint candidate, but no agreement emerged, with Atiku, Makinde and Peter Obi each pressing ahead with their own campaigns. Makinde said this week that talks with both Atiku and Obi remained open. ADC running mate Rotimi Amaechi also told a rally in Bauchi that the APM would win one South-West state.
more: Atiku and Makinde's camps have reportedly met.

stories.h: Zambia and Congo pull out of Miss Universe over US travel rules; Nigeria's queen arrives
stories.p: Zambia and the Republic of the Congo have withdrawn from Miss Universe 2026 in Puerto Rico after their contestants could not get US travel permission. Nigeria's Danielle Adewusi has arrived and joined preliminary events.
body: Two African countries have withdrawn from the 75th Miss Universe pageant because their contestants could not get permission to travel to Puerto Rico, a US territory.
## Who is affected

According to reports on Sunday, 15 November 2026, Zambia and the Republic of the Congo have pulled out, while representatives from Zimbabwe and South Sudan were still awaiting decisions ahead of the final on 24 November. Miss Universe Zambia said its representative, a 25-year-old registered nurse who won the national title in October, could not secure the required travel authorisation, and blamed US travel restrictions rather than any failing by her or the organisers. The Republic of the Congo had been due to send its first ever Miss Universe contestant.
## Nigeria's contestant
Nigeria is also affected by partial US entry restrictions, but its representative, Danielle Adewusi, arrived in San Juan on 9 November and has joined the preliminary activities.
## Background
Because Puerto Rico is a US territory, contestants travelling there must meet US immigration requirements.
more: Zambia and Congo withdrew over visa issues.
Nigeria's Danielle Adewusi has arrived.
The final is on 24 November.

stories.h: Governor Umo Eno stands as father, gifts car and ₦5m to bride raised in state orphanage
stories.p: Akwa Ibom governor Umo Eno attended the traditional wedding of a young woman abandoned at birth and raised in a state-run children's home, standing in as her father and gifting the couple a car and ₦5 million.
body: Akwa Ibom State governor Umo Eno has drawn praise after standing in as father of the bride at the wedding of a young woman raised in a state-owned children's home.
## The wedding

At the traditional marriage and reception held at Ibom Hall in Uyo, reported on Sunday, 15 November 2026, the governor presented the couple with a new car and ₦5 million. The bride was abandoned at birth and grew up in the state government's Special Children's Home in Uyo. She was given automatic employment in the state civil service by the governor in December 2025.
## What he said

Eno said it was a moment of great joy because the bride, who grew up without a home, had now been given one, and said he hoped her story would inspire others that everyone has a destiny regardless of the circumstances of their birth. He thanked the groom, urged him to love and protect his wife, and warned against domestic violence.

stories.h: All 62 contacts of Nigeria's Ebola case complete monitoring with no spread, NCDC says
stories.p: The NCDC says all 62 people linked to Nigeria's single imported case of Bundibugyo virus disease, a type of Ebola, have completed 21 days of monitoring with no further transmission. It warns this is not yet a declaration that Nigeria is free of the disease.
body: The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC) says all 62 contacts linked to the country's imported case of Bundibugyo virus disease, a species of Ebola, have completed their monitoring without any further spread.
## The update

Speaking at a news conference in Abuja on Friday, 13 November 2026, NCDC Director-General Dr Jide Idris said the last contact had been discharged after completing the mandatory 21-day monitoring period. He said 13 of the contacts developed fever or other symptoms during monitoring but tested negative for the disease. Seven other alerts reported over three weeks in Adamawa, Rivers, Borno, Lagos and Ekiti were investigated, and all suspected cases tested negative.
## Not yet Ebola-free

Idris cautioned that the end of contact monitoring was not a formal declaration that Nigeria was free of the disease, and said surveillance must continue. He said any such declaration would depend on public health criteria and ongoing surveillance, especially as transmission continues in the Democratic Republic of Congo.
## Background

Earlier this week, the NCDC said 28 contacts were still under watch. The United States has temporarily barred travellers who have been in the DRC in the past 21 days. Health authorities urge anyone with symptoms such as fever, weakness or unexplained bleeding after travel to report to a health facility.
more: All 62 contacts have completed monitoring.
No further transmission was recorded.
Surveillance will continue.

stories.h: Judgment details: why the court sacked the Mark-led ADC leadership
stories.p: The certified copy of the judgment that voided the David Mark-led ADC leadership shows the judge found a key resignation letter was fabricated and ruled that the party's executive committee could not appoint national officers without an election.
body: Details of the Federal High Court judgment that nullified the David Mark-led leadership of the African Democratic Congress (ADC) have emerged from the certified true copy of the ruling.
## The resignation letter

Justice Peter Lifu, who delivered the judgment on 5 November 2026, examined three main issues. The first was a letter said to show that the party's deputy national chairman, Nafiu Bala Gombe, had resigned in May 2025, before the meeting that installed the new leadership. After comparing signatures, the judge found clear differences, described the letter as fictitious or fabricated and rejected it as evidence.
## Powers of the executive committee

The ADC argued that its constitution allowed the National Executive Committee to dissolve the old leadership and appoint a new one. The judge accepted that parties may run their internal affairs, but held that this cannot override the Constitution and the Electoral Act, which require parties to elect their principal officers through periodic democratic elections. He ruled that the committee's administrative powers did not allow it to appoint national executives in place of an election.
## No proof of a vote

The judge also found that the party could not show that members or delegates had been given the chance to vote for candidates of their choice, and said notifying INEC of a meeting was not the same as complying with the law.
## Background

The judgment also voided the primary that produced Atiku Abubakar as the ADC's presidential candidate. The party has appealed, and INEC says it will obey the final court decision. Atiku and his running mate Rotimi Amaechi are continuing to campaign.
more: The judge said a key resignation letter was fabricated.
He ruled officers must be elected, not appointed.
The ADC has appealed.
